stories.title: AI当“科研搭子”，你真的放心吗？

en.title: AI as a 'Research Partner' – Are You Really Comfortable?
en.summary: When researchers use AI to develop scientific ideas, questions arise about intellectual ownership and credit attribution for the resulting concepts and innovations.

stories.title: 美官员称美政府拟向以色列出售价值28亿美元军火

en.title: U.S. Official Says American Government Plans to Sell 2.8 Billion Dollars in Military Equipment to Israel
en.summary: A U.S. official disclosed that the American government intends to provide Israel with military equipment worth 2.8 billion dollars, including tens of thousands of powerful 2000-pound bombs.

stories.title: 美国10年期国债收益率一度升至2007年以来高点

en.title: U.S. 10-Year Treasury Yield Rises to Highest Level Since 2007
en.summary: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields reached 5.045% early on the 15th, marking their highest point since July 2007, driven by persistent inflation concerns and expectations of further Federal Reserve rate increases.

stories.title: 美国国会预算办公室：伊朗战争耗资超380亿美元

en.title: U.S. Congressional Budget Office: Iran War Costs Exceed 3.8 Billion Dollars
en.summary: The U.S. Congressional Budget Office reported that the total expenditure for American military operations related to Iran has surpassed 3.8 billion dollars.

stories.title: 2026上合组织数字经济论坛在乌鲁木齐开幕

en.title: 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Digital Economy Forum Opens in Urumqi
en.summary: The 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Digital Economy Forum opened in Urumqi on September 15. Government officials, business leaders, and academic experts from multiple countries gathered to discuss digital connectivity, digital trade, smart industries, and digital governance.

stories.title: 韩正出席第十三届北京香山论坛欢迎晚宴并致辞

en.title: Vice President Han Zheng Attends Welcome Banquet and Delivers Remarks at 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum
en.summary: Chinese Vice President Han Zheng attended the welcome banquet for the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum on September 15 and delivered remarks at the event.

stories.title: 2026中国—东盟青年主播创造营开营

en.title: 2026 China-ASEAN Youth Anchor Creation Camp Opens
en.summary: The 2026 China-ASEAN Youth Anchor Creation Camp opened in Nanning, Guangxi on September 15. Sixty young media professionals and exchange students from China and ASEAN nations gathered to participate in cross-border research and cultural exchange activities.

stories.title: 对俄免签一周年 绥芬河公路口岸跨境客流增长近三成

en.title: One Year After Visa-Free Agreement with Russia, Suifenhe Highway Port Sees Nearly 30% Increase in Cross-Border Passenger Traffic
en.summary: One year after implementing visa-free entry with Russia, the Suifenhe highway port reported a nearly 30 percent increase in cross-border passenger traffic. Russian visitors are entering China for tourism, shopping, and business activities with simplified customs procedures.

stories.title: Will ‘transactional’ America assist India in a future border crisis with China?

en.title: Will 'transactional' America assist India in a future border crisis with China?
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi met in New Delhi during the Brics summit, reaffirming their commitment to peace at their disputed border and strengthening economic ties. China's official statement highlighted the US role as a factor influencing India-China relations.

stories.title: Why I am grateful for Asean’s endless meetings

en.title: Why I am grateful for Asean's endless meetings
en.summary: A former Asean deputy foreign minister reflects on the organization's extensive diplomatic practice of frequent meetings, discussions, and formal statements among member nations to address disagreements and maintain dialogue.

stories.title: Trump says Kennedy Centre to close after judge bars name change

en.title: Trump says Kennedy Centre to close after judge bars name change
en.summary: President Trump announced the Kennedy Centre will close following a court ruling that prevents his name from being added to the building's exterior. The centre's board voted to shut down for renovations pending reversal of the judicial decision.

stories.title: Sanders and Bannon call for AI limits, as public unease grows

en.title: Sanders and Bannon call for AI limits, as public unease grows
en.summary: Senator Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon, a Trump ally, united to call for AI restrictions, warning of potential catastrophic consequences from the technology as public concern about AI risks expands beyond political and technology circles.

stories.title: Tighter scrutiny of Hong Kong IPOs could slow deal flow, analysts say

en.title: Tighter scrutiny of Hong Kong IPOs could slow deal flow, analysts say
en.summary: Hong Kong and mainland Chinese regulators are intensifying quality standards for IPOs, which may reduce the pace of new listings. Analysts indicate this will not diminish underlying demand for listings.

stories.title: Wrise Prestige accelerates mainland China expansion with new offices, AI lab

en.title: Wrise Prestige accelerates mainland China expansion with new offices, AI lab
en.summary: Singapore-based wealth manager Wrise Prestige is expanding in mainland China and investing heavily in artificial intelligence, including opening an AI laboratory in Guangzhou and allocating HK$30 million to AI development.

stories.title: As the American century ends, Asia’s renaissance begins

en.title: As the American century ends, Asia's renaissance begins
en.summary: The United States remains the world's largest economy but no longer dominates globally, while Asia's fastest-growing economies are rising. American trade policies are prompting partners to seek alternative investment and trade opportunities.

stories.title: Chinese firms’ export share to reach 31% by 2035 as global expansion deepens: Goldman Sachs

en.title: Chinese firms' export share to reach 31% by 2035 as global expansion deepens: Goldman Sachs
en.summary: Goldman Sachs projects Chinese companies will increase their average export market share to 31 percent by 2035 from 18 percent currently, with revenues expected to grow 3.6-fold over the same period across 40 global firms.

stories.title: Unitree’s US$30 billion stock wipe-off spurs regulatory caution on humanoid robot IPOs

en.title: Unitree's US$30 billion stock wipe-off spurs regulatory caution on humanoid robot IPOs
en.summary: Chinese humanoid robot maker Unitree Robotics has declined over 40 percent since listing, prompting Beijing regulators to consider stricter scrutiny of similar initial public offerings focusing on revenue sustainability and innovation capabilities.
